benches.description: TX HBT chain (pre-driver, FFE line driver) into 100 ohm, FFE off and on: swing, rise/fall, collector and reverse-Vbe stress, supply current
benches.corner_set: per request: one HBT process corner x 3 supplies x 3 temperatures; six requests give the 54-point PVT-full set
benches.limitations: R4 uses an ideal 100 ohm load, not the R18 pad model (placeholder). R16 covers the TX supply current only; RX and clock-path current are not measured here. R5 is graded at FFE off/on; the 4-step code sweep is tx-mos-ffe-en

benches.description: RX termination + pad + CTLE input: differential drive current, hence |Zdiff| at 0.1 and 5 GHz
benches.corner_set: 3 HBT process corners x 1.08/1.2/1.32 V x -40/27/125 C (PVT-full)
benches.limitations: Ideal resistors and a placeholder pad capacitance (PDK bondpad is empty); |Zdiff| only, SDD11 is not extracted, resistor corners not applied

benches.description: TX driver + pad network SDD22 (100 ohm differential) from 1 MHz to 10 GHz via a 100 ohm AC port; driver on (bias live, pair balanced, FFE slices off) and a driver-off reference (vbn = 0)
benches.corner_set: per request: 3 HBT/CAP/DIO ganged process corners x 1.08/1.2/1.32 V x -40/27/125 C (PVT-full)
benches.limitations: PLACEHOLDER PAD: the PDK bondpad model has no capacitance, so each bondpad is a 100 fF capacitor to ground (R18 budget); R6 cannot be graded against a real pad until #94. DC is approximated by 1 MHz (AC-coupled port). Driver-on is the FFE-off balanced-pair small-signal point; FFE-on slices and the mux/predriver input stage are not exercised (mux outputs replaced by their DC mid level). rsil is the behavioural stand-in at typical rsh, no resistor corner. No limits are attached: the bench reports SDD22, it does not claim a pass

benches.description: Receiving clock buffer clk_buf_quad driven by an ideal 5 GHz quadrature source: duty of the 0/180 and 90/270 pairs, 90 and 270 degree quadrature delays, swing and crossing slew
benches.corner_set: 3 HBT/CAP/DIO ganged process corners x 1.08/1.2/1.32 V x -40/27/125 C (PVT-full)
benches.limitations: RANDOM JITTER IS A GAP: a noise-free ngspice transient has no RJ and .noise is small-signal about DC, so no rms jitter is measured; the crossing slew is reported as the AM-to-PM factor only (RJ = noise rms / slew needs a declared noise source, not provided). Input clock is ideal (source quality not modelled; deterministic error here is the buffer's own). Load is a 20 fF placeholder per output. Duty and quadrature are read from differential pairs A (0/180) and B (90/270); single-ended duty is not measured

benches.description: Statistical eye over R14 with sampler offset Monte Carlo: pad amplitude for BER 1e-12 by dual-Dirac Q-scale extrapolation
benches.corner_set: 27-pt HBT PVT-full (ctle_ac record corners) x sampler offset MC draws
benches.limitations: Behavioural (DR-002): fitted only to the ctle_ac record (gain at 0.1/2.5/5 GHz per corner). UNFITTED ASSUMPTIONS, printed by every run: sampler offset/noise (no sampler Monte Carlo record exists), RJ/DJ, PD decision noise, CTLE roll-off above 5 GHz, analog loop delay (DR-007). TX FFE off; channel phase is a pure delay (symmetric pulse). No fit validation on held-out corners (DR-002 step 3). Figures are simulated/extrapolated, never measured.
